outcome.situation: a short simple telephone exchange or recorded message
outcome.observable_action: identify a person's name and phone number
outcome.essential_content: the contact details needed to return or record the call
outcome.independence: without a transcript or visible number
outcome.success_condition: the name and number are recorded accurately enough to use
outcome.statement: In a fresh short phone context, the learner can identify and record a name and phone number without a transcript.

evidence_refs.interpretation_note: The objective directly anchors identifying a caller's name and phone number.
A recorded-message variant supports the same phone-number purpose.

concurrent_support.rationale: Basic A1 language control accompanies the fresh performance.
Slow, supported reception and meaning inference accompanies this source-input or output channel.
Recognition of common cardinal numbers accompanies this source-input or output channel.

vocabulary.target: Personal names and spoken phone-number digits
vocabulary.purpose: record the contact details needed to return or log a call

evidence_refs.interpretation_note: The objective directly anchors identifying a caller's name and phone number.
A recorded-message variant supports the same phone-number purpose.

phrases.target: Short telephone and recorded-message contact-detail frames
phrases.purpose: locate the caller name and phone number in context

evidence_refs.interpretation_note: The objective directly anchors identifying a caller's name and phone number.

pronunciation.target: Discrimination and grouping of spoken name and phone-number detail
pronunciation.purpose: produce a usable written record without seeing the number

evidence_refs.interpretation_note: The objective directly anchors identifying a caller's name and phone number.
A recorded-message variant supports the same phone-number purpose.

error_hypotheses.error: The learner omits, substitutes, or groups a spoken phone-number digit incorrectly.
error_hypotheses.impact: The recorded contact detail is not accurate enough to use.
error_hypotheses.basis: Candidate-specific hypothesis for Arabic-speaking A1 adults based on the exact digit-recording demand; it is not a source fact and requires expert and learner validation.

mastery.fresh_task_family: A fresh short call or message containing one name and one phone number.

level_2_evidence.comprehension: Recognizes which spoken items are the caller's contact details.
level_2_evidence.outcome_performance: Records the required name and phone number accurately.
level_2_evidence.interaction_or_transfer: Succeeds with a new voice and number pattern.

critical_failures: The recorded number cannot be used because a digit is missing or changed.
non_blocking_errors: Nonessential punctuation or spacing in the written number.
permitted_support: One replay of the complete audio; a neutral field label for name and phone.
disallowed_help: A complete model answer or answer-revealing cue.
mastery.delayed_probe: Use a different caller and number after a delay.

scope.load_rationale: One name and one phone number in a short audio.

risks: Number length and delivery must remain realistic but A1-bounded.
Target-decision note: No separate grammar target is assigned because the cited performance depends on accurate contact-detail recognition, not control of a clause pattern.
